newsitem.title: USA: IDEX Corp sees record results in 1997.
newsitem.headline: IDEX Corp sees record results in 1997.

text.p: IDEX Corp said Tuesday that, barring unforeseen circumstances, it expects record sales, net income and earnings per share in 1997.
In 1996, it earned $50.2 million or $1.69 a share on sales of $562.6 million.
Earlier, IDEX reported first quarter earnings of $0.45 a share, up from $0.41 a year ago. Sales were up 13 percent to $151.8 million, reflecting Fluid Management that was acquired in July 1996.
"The business pace seems to be steady at a high level," chairman Donald Boyce said in a statement.
Incoming orders in the first quarter were $159.2 million and exceeded shipments by $7.4 million. First quarter orders increased by about three percent from the fourth quarter of 1996, it added.
"While we continue to run with relatively low backlogs of unfilled orders, the somewhat higher backlog improves our prospects for the second quarter," Boyce said.

In the first quarter, IDEX said its fluid handling group generated 77 percent of sales and 81 prcent of profits, and its industrial products group contributed 23 percent of sales and 19 percent of profits.
